title: Choosing a scheduler from the curves

questions.q: Why can you check a scheduler without a GPU?
options: Its output is a list of numbers made before the model runs
It does not affect the picture
questions.answer: Its output is a list of numbers made before the model runs
questions.why: nm_sigmas prints schedules on a CPU with no model.

questions.q: linear_quadratic's last value before 0 on SDXL is 2.67. What does that mean?
options: The last step leaps from heavy noise to clean in one go
It adds noise at the end
questions.answer: The last step leaps from heavy noise to clean in one go
questions.why: karras has 0.03 there, so its last jump is tiny.

questions.q: Why does karras behave differently on a flow model?
options: Its formula spends most steps at low noise, which on a 0 to 1 range leaves few steps at high noise
questions.answer: Its formula spends most steps at low noise, which on a 0 to 1 range leaves few steps at high noise
questions.why: Only 4 of 20 steps sit above σ 0.5, against 15 for simple.

questions.q: What does the lab's comparison of SD3.5 karras and kl_optimal numbers teach?
options: Summary measures can't tell a broken render from a fine one, so look at the picture
questions.answer: Summary measures can't tell a broken render from a fine one, so look at the picture
questions.why: The difference, brightness and edge numbers are close, and only one of the two pictures is broken.

questions.q: You ask ddim_uniform for 30 steps on a 1000-entry table. How many do you get?
questions.why: ss = 1000 // 30 = 33, and the loop from index 1 returns 31 values before the end, as the lab shows.
